label: D1 update gate: high after reaching S2, low after reward and after rare a2->S1
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 38. Almost all variance is at D1 (mean ~0.5-0.68, rising over the episode); GO and D2 are near 0. Beyond timing, the D1 value is set by the previous trial: higher (+0.37) when the previous trial reached S2, lower (-0.22) when the reward input is 1, and lower still (-0.17) when the previous trial was a rare a2->S1 transition (so a2 S1 r is the lowest, a1/a2 S2 u the highest). A term for the window-start trial (previous trial unknown in the window, +0.15) absorbs a fitting artifact. A small GO bump after a1 rewarded. Trial-before reward/state, the model policy logit and value add little (<0.015). All terms are observed. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.77 vs the all ceiling 0.82 (all observed 0.80).

issues: The (prev_state == -1) term lumps two cases together: the window's first trial, where the previous trial is unknown (+0.15), and the episode's very first trial t0. At t0 the gate is about 0.12 against a predicted 0.66; the misses output lists several t0 cells among the worst fits. Adding (phase==D1)*(ep_trial==0) gets weight -0.54 and lifts test R^2 beyond timing from 0.7725 to 0.779, so the explanation's line about the windowing artifact is incomplete. The effect is small.

The remaining errors are minor: D1 after a1 S2 r is under-predicted by +0.071, and D1 after a2 S2 u and after a1 S1 r are over-predicted by about -0.05. They come from a small reward x S2 interaction. Adding that term plus a t0 term and an S2 x ep_dec term reaches 0.788 test. No large systematic error class remains.

The other claims check out against the profile tables and the term ablations. The value is near 0 at GO and D2. At D1 it is highest after S2 unrewarded (+0.34/+0.32) and lowest after a2 S1 r (-0.39). The S2, reward and rare-a2->S1 effects are roughly additive. All terms use observed variables only.
